required_quantitative_inputs: Cumulative production on a stable quality-adjusted unit basis
Unit production cost and selling price at matching dates
Demand sensitivity, capacity growth, utilization and financing needs
research_checks: Fit a learning relationship to observed comparable data; keep price distinct from manufacturing cost.
Model slower cumulative-volume growth and weaker demand elasticity separately.
Track whether incremental cost improvement is retained in margin or passed to buyers.
falsifiers_or_contrary_mechanisms: Learning fit breaks under architecture shifts or input scarcity.
Production does not double as expected; cheaper pricing fails to unlock adoption.
Price competition transfers savings away from equity owners.
